erin: Heads-up — I sketched a small refactor for the precision interop layer to decouple runtime <-> quant profiles. Goal: make profiles a first-class ABI so we can add FP8/INT8/4-bit rules without touching kernel code. High level: handshake + signature, telemetry hooks, and graceful fallback policies.
sam: Can you drop the short summary or link? Curious how the handshake looks.
erin: Short version inline: negotiation happens at request start. Runtime advertises supported_formats; profile carries a stable signature so runtime can fast-path compatible profiles. Example payload:
```
{
  "model": "llama-2-13b",
  "precision_profile": "fp8-prefer-int8-fallback",
  "profile_sig": "sha256:abcd1234",
  "negotiation_mode": "best-effort"
}
```
If sig mismatch -> fallback policy triggers (can be strict/reject, degrade-to-int8, or run-hosted).
maya: My main worry is perf cliff when we fall back mid-inference or when profile mismatches require model reloads. How do we guarantee no head-of-line blocking?
erin: Good call. Plan: negotiation at the start of request only. If runtime can't honor full fp8 hotpath, it either accepts a compatible int8/4bit variant or signals a "defer-to-hosted" codepath. No mid-stream swaps. We maintain per-shard compatibility bitmask so check is O(1).
lee: We also need to define telemetry hooks in the ABI: publish negotiated_precision, degradation_score (0-1), kernel_variant, and profile_sig. Add per-request trace_id so we can join with evals.
sam: For rollout: canary flag + sampling. Suggest adding optional `precision_trial={seed:,rate:}` in profile so we can sample requests into fp8 path. Also need CI linting to ensure profile_sig format and required keys.
erin: Agreed. Lint rules: required keys = [model, precision_profile, profile_sig, negotiation_mode]. Also we should add a compatibility test matrix in infra (rack-level) to prevent shipping profiles unsupported by prod kernels.
runtime-bot: Canary job precision-interop-v2 passed: 6/6 perf lanes ok, one regression <2% in tail latency (investigating).
maya: I'll prototype the handshake shim in a proof-of-concept PR (will include compatibility bitmask and fallback enum). PR will be labeled `eng-ml/precision-interop`.
erin: Awesome — once PR lands I'll add telemetry wiring + perf tests. We should add an ops playbook entry for rollback when degradation_score > 0.15 for 10m.
lee: Also add an emergency toggle at routing layer to force model variant by profile_sig.
erin: Got it. Thanks all. I'll post the RFC follow-up doc with diagrams and an example ABI spec later today.
sam: :thumbsup:
runtime-bot: Note: please include kernel capability matrix in PR to help canary infra map lanes.
jen (FYI): CCing infra in case of infra churn.
